summary: Build sharper media and thought-leadership writing skills with practical templates, drafting drills, and editorial workflows. Enrol today.
lede: Writing for media and thought leadership turns expert insight into clear, sourced content suited to publication and review. For communications, public relations, content and corporate affairs professionals, the course covers selecting newsworthy angles, handling evidence and quotes, structuring bylined articles and op-eds, and adapting pitches and commentary to different outlets.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already write in a business context and now need to produce stronger media and thought-leadership content with sharper judgment, cleaner structure, and more editorial confidence.
prerequisites: Prerequisites: Intermediate writing experience and familiarity with corporate communications, PR, editorial, or content work. You should already be able to draft clear business prose and work with subject matter experts. No coding is required. Participants should bring a laptop for writing exercises, plus access to a word processor and, where available, a content review or collaboration tool used in their organization. Advanced writing theory is covered only at an operational level, while editorial planning and AI-assisted drafting are handled through guided practice and templates.
